title: Add promotion blocker panel
purpose: Make release blockers visible and actionable from the Console Beta operator shell.
scope: Render promotion.status and promotion.blockers from release provenance.
Group blockers by tests, boot smoke, replay, signing, provenance and ecosystem readiness.
Show evidence path and safe next command for each blocker.
Represent skipped gates as blockers when promotion requires them.
Avoid allowing TUI to override blocker status.
acceptance_criteria: Promotion blockers are visible when provenance reports blockers.
Skipped required gates are shown distinctly from passed gates.
TUI cannot clear blockers or mutate provenance.
Blocker view is deterministic and redacted.
failure_modes: Skipped tests are displayed as pass.
Operator can dismiss promotion blocker as UI-only state.
Blocker panel hides signing or QEMU requirements.
